changelog.title: What's New in 8.1.0
items: Remade game modal with sleek side menu and tabbed interface
Added selectable tabs: Details, Achievements, News, SteamLite
SteamLite achievements now show per-game progress (e.g., Game Master for 100 hours)
Profile UI modernized with stats in banner and online indicator on avatar
Added Play Together button for friend profiles
Added Friends in Common display on profiles
Dashboard improvements: removed stats, pinned news, added drag-to-reorder sections
Library filter bar replaced with modern dropdown
Refresh button now only shows on Library and Favorites tabs
Advanced settings reorganized into collapsible Extra section

news.title: SteamLite 8.1.0 Major UI Update
news.content: SteamLite 8.1.0 is now available with major UI improvements including a redesigned game modal with tabs, modernized profile pages, dashboard repositioning, and many bug fixes and polish. All 8.0.0 features remain intact.

news.title: We Are Hiring!
news.content: Join the SteamLite development team! We're looking for passionate developers to help us build the future of Steam client alternatives.
